preflight.ego_inputs: Recorded robot inputs from each reference, unchanged; counterfactual test, not closed-loop avoidance.

criteria: Declare plan before component/native execution; one attempt per cell, no overwrite or automatic retry. Commit runtime before native capture.

Change only the upper moving-group velocity proposal: normalized native goal preference replaces rigid group-circle ORCA. Native per-person ORCA/swept projection, group smoothing/noise/RNG/turn/speed/goal/lifecycle logic, simulation clock and all Nav2/robot/camera parameters remain unchanged.

Component launch gate: old group_orca_v1 must exactly reproduce the120 reference worker human XY/yaw samples; candidate must finish120 same-ego steps without fault and every predicted per-person guard clearance must stay positive. Any failure is preserved and blocks this series pending diagnosis.

Component motion screen: flag aggregate yaw reduction<50% versus matched reference, maximum group member distance from centroid more than.25m over reference, or backward-moving fraction more than.05 over reference. These are diagnostics, not launch gating if safety/identity passes.
Native: camera/depth/TF/native costmap/GPU/clock/direct-group-intent source and trace integrity must PASS.
Native physical screen: SUCCEEDED with independent actual XY<=.2m/yaw<=.25rad, positive continuous swept robot/human and human/human/static clearance, zero progress failures/action recoveries.
Native encounter coverage: center distance<=1.5m for>=.5s union duration and initial intent>=1s first12s. Missing coverage is NOT_EXERCISED, not avoidance acceptance.

Native motion screen: mean full-episode yaw rate at least50% below its reference, moving-group maximum member-centroid radius no more than reference+.25m, and backward-moving fraction no more than reference+.05. Compare measured trajectories with unpinned MPPI RNG; no isolated causal or multi-seed naturalness claim.

No collision-guard weakening, forced robot commands/waypoints, controller tuning, goal/tolerance relaxation or timeout shortening. Preserve all failures; no default promotion or WM/RL dataset registration in this bounded series.
